audience: Swedish companies that manage receipts, supplier invoices and bank matching in Kvittia

useCases.title: Find receipts that are new or not booked
useCases.text: List the company's receipts, newest first, filtered by date, status, category or text. Read one receipt for its amount, VAT and account.

useCases.title: Review supplier invoices waiting for payment
useCases.text: List supplier invoices with their approval and payment status, then open one for its number, dates, amount and bank details.

useCases.title: Find bank lines with no receipt or invoice
useCases.text: List bank transactions and filter for the lines that have no supporting document attached.

useCases.title: Check a Swedish company by organisation number
useCases.text: Look up one company by its organisation number: registration, SNI codes, latest figures and the risk analysis.

useCases.title: Upload a receipt and mark it booked
useCases.text: Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF receipt for Kvittia to read. Set its status to booked after the accounting system records it.
